_comment: Soft-coded config for Equipment List extraction. Tune labels, patterns and Excel layout here — no Python changes needed.

extraction._comment_ocr: ocr_rotation_angles: try each angle (degrees) during OCR fallback — covers horizontal (0/180) and vertical (90/270) text on P&IDs; add 45/135 here if diagonal text present
extraction._comment_psm: ocr_psm_modes: Tesseract page-segmentation modes per rotation. 6=uniform block (title blocks/tables), 11=sparse (scattered tags). Both run per angle and unique results are merged.
extraction._comment_scale: ocr_render_scale: DPI multiplier for rendering scanned pages before OCR. 3.0 gives ~216 dpi @ 72dpi base — enough for small tag text on P&IDs
extraction._comment_area: area_pattern: capture group 1 returns the code/number only (not the keyword). Add more keywords here as needed.
extraction._comment_area_heuristic: area_from_tag_heuristic: derive area code from serial number digits when no keyword found (V-101→100, P-2201→2200)
extraction._comment_area_ctx: area_context_chars: chars each side of tag to scan for area keyword (wider than ctx window to reach title blocks)
extraction._comment_desc_ctx: description_context_chars: wider post-tag window for newline-based description extraction
extraction._comment_desc_min: description_min_word_length: tokens shorter than this are skipped in description extraction
extraction._comment_nozzle: nozzle_pattern: nozzle tags N1/N-1/N1A. N[-]? covers both N1 and N-1 styles common on P&IDs
extraction._comment_nozzle_ctx: nozzle_context_chars: scanner radius (chars) each side of tag — wider catches nozzle schedules in separate table blocks
extraction._comment_material: material_class_pattern: covers O&G steel grades, piping spec codes, alloys, plastics and ASTM grades
extraction._comment_material_label: material_label_pattern: label-based extraction e.g. MATERIAL: CS, SHELL: SS316L, MTL: DUPLEX — capture group 1 is the value
extraction._comment_mat_ctx: material_context_chars: scanner radius for material code — 400 chars reaches most equipment data boxes
extraction._comment_service_label: service_label_pattern: label-based fluid extraction e.g. SERVICE: CRUDE OIL, FLUID: GAS — capture group 1 is the value
extraction._comment_service_ctx: service_context_chars: scanner radius for service/fluid — wider context reaches service labels on equipment bubbles
extraction._comment_notes: note_pattern: NOTE/SEE NOTE/HOLD/TBD/TBC/REF.DWG references adjacent to equipment
